title: Linnik's constant is at most 3.99: A formalization of a weighted version of Heath-Brown's near-density estimate, and of the proof's certificate checker
summary: Two components of the proof, in the paper "Linnik's constant is at most 3.99" (paper/linnik399.pdf in this repository), that every reduced residue class modulo q contains a prime below q^3.99 for all large q. That bound itself is NOT formally verified here: the paper's zero-location arguments, case analysis and exterior regimes have conventional proofs and computer checks only. review.reason: Lean formalization of components of a proof bounding Linnik's constant.
